title: Decaying Film Director
description: A pale, green-skinned figure with sunken eyes sits in a ruined room, wearing a dark hooded cloak covered in 'GUESS' text. The figure operates an old film projector that casts a beam of light and unspools bloody film reels, while holding a painter's palette stained with red paint.
prompt: A haunting surreal scene of a zombie-like artist with green decaying skin and sunken eyes, wearing a dark hooded cloak covered in repeating 'GUESS' text, sitting in a crumbling derelict room with peeling classical frescoes on the walls. He operates a vintage film projector that beams light and spills bloody film strips showing miniature scenes, while holding a painter's palette dripping with red paint. Dramatic cinematic lighting, dark moody atmosphere, decaying cinematic aesthetic.
